ValidationRule.description: #GITLAB:5038 --> To throw an error while updating the invoice scheduler if post bill or pre bill is checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'QTB_Bill_Flow_Controller__c'))), ISCHANGED( Invoice_Scheduler__c ), OR( Execute_Post_Bill_Run__c = TRUE, Execute_Pre_Bill_Run__c = TRUE) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice Scheduler Can not be updated once Pre Bill or Post Bill Checked
